en: Going in? The sea comes and goes in this cave twice a day. Some corners are dry only while the tide is out.
Bring me four Shoal Salt and four Shoal Shells, and I'll make you something you'll be glad of.
Four Shoal Salt and four Shoal Shells! Shall I make them into a Shell Bell for you?
Leave it to me. It won't take a moment!
Let a Pokémon hold the Shell Bell, and every blow it lands gives it back a little HP. Its ring is soothing, too.
No? I'll be here whenever you change your mind.
